notes: Cluster registry for targeted hot-page validation. Canonical matching is based on page_offsets, not absolute addresses, because Dolphin RAM base addresses drift between runs. Current evidence shows a grounded coin_total_change_once hot cluster. Recent validator runs for inboard_event_transition_once and board_space_land_once collapsed onto the same coin_total_change_once cluster, so they remain unseparated and ungrounded as distinct action signatures.

coin_total_change_once.notes: Grounded from repeated validator matches. Recent runs continue to overlap this cluster for coin_total_change_once, and other attempted actions are currently collapsing onto the same hot pages. Treat page_offsets as canonical. absolute_addresses_example is informative only.

inboard_event_transition_once.notes: Do not treat prior offsets as a distinct cluster. Latest validator run matched coin_total_change_once with overlap=3/3 score=1.0, so the current transition signature is not separable from the coin_total cluster.

board_space_land_once.notes: Still ungrounded. Latest validator run matched coin_total_change_once rather than a distinct board-space cluster. Leave empty until repeated captures produce a stable separable signature.
